title: Punjab Local Government Fourth Amendment Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Local Government Fourth Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1996
PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT (FOURTH
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
ACT I OF 1996
An Act further to amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 21st May, 1996]
No.Legis-2(2)/96/61, dated
21-5-1996.--The Punjab Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Bill, 1996, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 9th day of May,
1996 and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 15th day of May,
1996, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be -called the
Punjab Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 1st day of July, 1990.

2. Amendment of section 7 of Act I of 1993.--In the Punjab
Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993 (I of 1993), in
section 7, after clause (t), the following shall be added:--
"(ta)
direct the eviction of tenants from any of the properties vested in the
Board."
